items.jp: なかなか興味深いことをおっしゃいますね？
items.kana: なかなかきょうみふかいことをおっしゃいますね?

structure_explanation.en: Topic 彼の心配 ('his worry'), marked by は. Central verb なくなる ('to vanish'), here te-form + いる: なくなっていた. Since いる is past (た), なくなっていた = 'had vanished', a state already completed in the past. Adverb すっかり ('completely') reinforces totality.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: O advérbio なかなか intensifica o adjetivo seguinte: 'bem / bastante'. 興味深い ('interessante') é um adjetivo-i que modifica こと ('coisa'), formando o objeto 興味深いこと marcado por を. O verbo おっしゃる é a forma honorífica (尊敬語) de 言う ('dizer'), aqui em おっしゃいます (forma polida -ます), mostrando respeito por quem fala. A partícula final ね pede concordância: 'não é?'.

translation_literal.en: A rather interesting thing [you] say, don't you?
translation_literal.pt-BR: Coisa bastante interessante [o senhor] diz, né?

translation.en: You say really interesting things, don't you?
translation.pt-BR: O senhor diz coisas bem interessantes, não é?

role.en: component of the adjective 興味深い
role.pt-BR: componente do adjetivo 興味深い

conjugation_note.en: i-adjective 深い ('deep') in dictionary form, compounded with 興味
conjugation_note.pt-BR: adjetivo-i 深い ('profundo') na forma de dicionário, em composto com 興味

conjugation_note.en: 連用形 stem of おっしゃる (honorific of 言う), followed by ます
conjugation_note.pt-BR: raiz 連用形 de おっしゃる (honorífico de 言う), seguida de ます

findings.issue: expl_en describes a completely different sentence (topic 彼の心配, verb なくなっていた, adverb すっかり) — none of that is in this sentence. It must explain なかなか + 興味深いこと + honorific おっしゃいます + ね, as expl_pt correctly does.
findings.current: Topic 彼の心配 ('his worry'), marked by は. Central verb なくなる ('to vanish'), here te-form + いる: なくなっていた. Since いる is past (た)...
findings.proposed: The adverb なかなか intensifies the following adjective: 'quite / rather'. 興味深い ('interesting', lit. 'of deep interest') is an i-adjective modifying こと ('thing'), forming the object 興味深いこと, marked by を. The verb おっしゃる is the honorific (尊敬語) form of 言う ('to say'), here as おっしゃいます (polite -ます form), showing respect toward the person addressed. The final particle ね seeks agreement: 'don't you?'.

items.jp: 彼にはいつもびっくりさせられる。
items.kana: かれにわいつもびっくりさせられる。

structure_explanation.en: This is a sentence with the causative-passive 〜させられる (the target): びっくりする ("to be surprised") becomes びっくりさせられる, which literally is "to be made/forced to be surprised." In natural English it comes as "he amazes me / I can't help being surprised by him." 彼には marks the cause/agent ("by him") and いつも ("always") indicates frequency.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: Esta é uma frase com o causativo-passivo 〜させられる (o alvo): びっくりする ("ficar surpreso") vira びっくりさせられる, que literalmente é "ser levado/forçado a ficar surpreso". Em pt-BR fica natural como "ele me deixa surpreso / não consigo deixar de me surpreender com ele". 彼には marca a causa/o agente ("por ele") e いつも ("sempre") indica frequência.

translation_literal.en: As for him, [I] am always made to be surprised.
translation_literal.pt-BR: Quanto a ele, sempre (eu) sou feito surpreender(-me).

gloss.en: to be surprised, to get a fright

role.en: object/verb root (forms the verb びっくりする)
role.pt-BR: objeto/raiz verbal (forma o verbo びっくりする)

gloss.en: to do (part of びっくりする)
gloss.pt-BR: fazer (parte de びっくりする)

conjugation_note.en: stem さ- of する in the causative-passive base
conjugation_note.pt-BR: raiz さ- de する na base causativa-passiva

conjugation_note.en: causative auxiliary せ(る) over する → ささせ... contracted to させ
conjugation_note.pt-BR: auxiliar causativo せ(る) sobre する → ささせ... contraído em させ

conjugation_note.en: passive auxiliary られる; together they form させられる (causative-passive)
conjugation_note.pt-BR: auxiliar passivo られる; junto formam させられる (causativo-passivo)

findings.issue: Note invents a nonexistent form: claims させ results from 'ささせ... contracted'. させる is simply さ (mizenkei of する) + auxiliary せる; no ささせ, no contraction. The parallel note in sent:tatoeba-118746 states it correctly.
findings.current: auxiliar causativo せ(る) sobre する → ささせ... contraído em させ / causative auxiliary せ(る) over する → ささせ... contracted to させ
findings.proposed: せ = base do auxiliar causativo せる sobre さ- (未然形 de する) → させ; sem contração / same in en, no 'ささせ'

items.jp: 足を踏むつもりはなかったのです。
items.kana: あしをふむつもりわなかったのです。

structure_explanation.en: The sentence uses the pattern 〜つもり (intention/purpose): the verb 踏む (to step on) in dictionary form links to つもり forming 'the intention of stepping on'. Then comes は (topic) + なかった (the negative past form of ない/ある) = 'there was no (such intention)'. The ending のです (の + です) gives an explanatory tone, like someone making an excuse. The target is 'coverage' (general N4 review).
structure_explanation.pt-BR: A frase usa o padrão 〜つもり (intenção/propósito): o verbo 踏む (pisar) na forma de dicionário liga-se a つもり formando 'a intenção de pisar'. Em seguida vem は (tópico) + なかった (forma negativa passada de ない/ある) = 'não havia (essa intenção)'. O fecho のです (の + です) dá um tom explicativo, como quem se justifica. O alvo é 'coverage' (revisão geral de N4).

translation_literal.en: As for the intention to step on your foot, there was none.
translation_literal.pt-BR: Quanto a (ter) a intenção de pisar no pé, não havia.

translation.pt-BR: Eu não tive a intenção de pisar no seu pé.

conjugation_note.en: dictionary form of 踏む
conjugation_note.pt-BR: forma de dicionário de 踏む

conjugation_note.en: past negative form of ない (なかった)
conjugation_note.pt-BR: forma negativa passada de ない (なかった)

items.jp: 贈り物として包んでいただけませんか。
items.kana: おくりものとしてつつんでいただけませんか。

structure_explanation.en: Polite request built on 〜ていただけませんか ('would it be possible for me to receive from you the favor of …?'), one of the most courteous ways to ask for something. The main verb is 包む ('to wrap'), in the te-form (包んで) + いただける ('to be able to receive [a favor]') in the negative-interrogative ませんか, which makes the request softer. 贈り物として ('as a gift') uses として ('in the capacity of / as') to indicate the purpose of the wrapping. Since the target is just coverage, highlight the polite request formula.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: Pedido educado construído sobre 〜ていただけませんか ('seria possível eu receber, de você, o favor de …?'), uma das formas mais corteses de pedir algo. O verbo principal é 包む ('embrulhar'), na forma て (包んで) + いただける ('poder receber [um favor]') na negativa-interrogativa ませんか, o que torna o pedido mais suave. 贈り物として ('como presente') usa として ('na qualidade de / como') para indicar a finalidade do embrulho. Como o alvo é só 'cobertura', destaque a fórmula de pedido educado.

translation_literal.en: Could I have you wrap it as a gift, please?
translation_literal.pt-BR: Fazendo-o como presente, eu poderia receber (de você) o embrulhar?, não é?

translation.pt-BR: Você poderia embrulhar isso para presente, por favor?

gloss.en: to do (part of として, 'as/in the capacity of')
gloss.pt-BR: fazer (parte de として, 'como/na qualidade de')

items.jp: 船はどんどん川を下って入った。
items.kana: ふねわどんどんかわをくだってはいった。

structure_explanation.en: Topic 船 ('boat') by は. Target is N4 coverage. 川を下って uses を to mark the river as the path of 下る ('to go down'), in 〜て chaining actions; どんどん is a mimetic/intensifying adverb ('more and more'). Final verb 入った ('entered', past of 入る) links via the 〜て form.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: O tópico é 船 ("barco"), marcado por は. O alvo é cobertura N4. 川を下って usa を para marcar o rio como trajeto do movimento 下る ("descer"), na forma 〜て que encadeia ações; どんどん é advérbio mimético/intensificador ("sem parar, cada vez mais"). O verbo final 入った ("entrou", passado de 入る) liga-se ao trecho anterior pela forma 〜て.

translation_literal.en: The boat went swiftly down the river.

translation.pt-BR: O barco descia o rio cada vez mais rápido.

gloss.pt-BR: sem parar, cada vez mais, rapidamente

conjugation_note.en: stem of the 〜て form 下って of 下る
conjugation_note.pt-BR: raiz da forma 〜て 下って de 下る

conjugation_note.en: stem of the past form 入った of 入る
conjugation_note.pt-BR: raiz da forma passada 入った de 入る

conjugation_note.en: た, past marker of 入る
conjugation_note.pt-BR: た, marca de passado de 入る

findings.issue: Corrupt Tanaka source: 下って入った ('entered', no destination) is unnatural and contradicts this record's own en/pt/lit_en ('went/rolling down the river'); Tatoeba's EN/FI pairs show the intended verb was 行った. Fix jp to 下って行った (re-derive kana/tokens/expl) or drop the sentence.

findings.proposed: 船はどんどん川を下って行った。 — apply only with a provenance flag (source_corrected vs Tatoeba 141147); otherwise drop the sentence rather than silently diverge from Layer A.

findings.issue: Teaches 入った = 'entered' (past of 入る), a claim contradicted by the sentence's own en/pt translations; the intended final verb is 行った ('went'), the 〜て行く pattern of continuing motion (下って行った).
findings.current: Final verb 入った ('entered', past of 入る) links via the 〜て form.
findings.proposed: Final verb 行った ('went', past of 行く) links via the 〜て form: 下って行った 'went on down'.

findings.current: O verbo final 入った ("entrou", passado de 入る) liga-se ao trecho anterior pela forma 〜て.
findings.proposed: O verbo final 行った ("foi", passado de 行く) liga-se ao trecho anterior pela forma 〜て (下って行った).

items.jp: 身体を大事にしなければならない。
items.kana: しんたいをだいじにしなければならない。

translation_literal.en: As for the body, if you don't treat it as important, it won't do.
translation_literal.pt-BR: Quanto ao corpo, se não (o) tratar com importância, não vira (= não pode ser).

structure_explanation.en: The target structure is 〜なければならない (obligation). The verbal core is 大事にする ('to treat with care/to value'), whose negative conditional form 大事にしなければ ('if I don't take good care') takes ならない. 身体を is the direct object ('the body'), and 大事に is the 形状詞 大事 used adverbially with に.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: A estrutura-alvo é 〜なければならない (obrigação). O núcleo verbal é 大事にする ('tratar com cuidado/dar valor a'), cuja forma negativa condicional 大事にしなければ ('se não cuidar bem') recebe ならない. 身体を é o objeto direto ('o corpo'), e 大事に é o 形状詞 大事 usado adverbialmente com に.

translation.pt-BR: É preciso cuidar bem do próprio corpo.

conjugation_note.en: 形状詞 大事 used adverbially: 大事に ('carefully/with value')
conjugation_note.pt-BR: 形状詞 大事 usado adverbialmente: 大事に ('com cuidado/valor')
